items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And I used to go out there with my father and hear them play the concert music.

ctx.x: I used to go when I was a child. Maybe 10 or 12 years old when my daddy played out at Spanish Fort. In the afternoon, they used to have a concert band. Pal Eddie was a conductor. Pil된 stuff with stuff

And I used to go out there with my father and hear them play the concert music. Was that the West End Band? No, that was Spanish Fort. That was Spanish Fort Band. There was a batch of bands my daddy was with. I mean, Armin Vesey was with his band. I don't know if you ever heard of Armin Vesey? Yeah. He was one of the teachers of, he taught everybody how to play. He had a style of teaching trumpet that you didn't pick up a trumpet until after you played with a mouthpiece for three months. He got the feel of a…
No, there was another son I think I talked to.
